module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Liquidity Provider Partial Fill (50% Block Filled)
precondition: Master sends 10.0 lots across 10 equal sub-accounts; LP only fills 5.0 lots.
steps: 1. Broker bridge returns partial fill execution report of 5.0 lots.
expected: MAM engine apportions the 5.0 filled lots proportionally (0.50 lots per sub-account); remaining 5.0 lots remain working or cancel per TIF.
coverage_note: Requires LP partial-fill, depth, rejection, or routing fault injection; these dedicated accounts are B-book and no LP simulator was supplied.
